PrayerDuringMenstruation.6: Kutheni umthandazo wesiko umisiwe ngeli xesha, nendlela yokuwufumana ngayo lo mzuzu ngokuthula.

PrayerDuringMenstruation.11: Akukho kuthandaza okuphosiweyo, ngokungafaniyo nokuzila ukutya
PrayerDuringMenstruation.14: Ngexesha lokuya exesheni, uxanduva lomthandazo (isalati) lumisiwe: ibhinqa alifuneki lithandaze ngeli xesha.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.15: Ukuxothwa oku akuthethi ukuzahlula elukholweni okanye ukuphazamiseka kwindlela yokunqula.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.17: Eli xesha linokufikelelwa ngokuthuthuzela: alibuthandabuzi ubuncwane bokholo okanye ukuhleleka komsebenzi wonqulo.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.18: Ukuba iminyhadala iqala ngoxa kuthandazwa, iyaphazamiseka: akuyomfuneko ukuba igqitywe okanye yenziwe. Ngokwahlukileyo koko, xa iminyhadala iphela, umthandazo uyaqhubeka ngokuqhelekileyo emva kwe-ghusl (ukuhlambuluka okukhulu), okubonisa ukubuyela kwimeko yobunyulu besiko.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.19: Ngokungafaniyo nokuzila ukutya kweRamadan, apho iintsuku eziphulukayo ngexesha lokuya exesheni zenziwa kamva (qadaa), imithandazo ephulukayo ngenxa yesi sizathu esifanayo ngokuqhelekileyo ayenziwa emva koko. Lo mahluko uchazwa yimvelo yezi zenzo zimbini zonqulo: umthandazo sisenzo semihla ngemihla esiphindaphindwayo izihlandlo eziliqela ngosuku, ngelixa ukuzila ukutya kunyaka kwaye kugxininiswe kwinyanga ethile.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.20: Lo mahluko unokuba yinto emangalisayo xa uqala ukufumanisa i-fiqh. Akuthethi kuthi umthandazo ubaluleke ngaphantsi: ukulandela ukungeniswa njengoko kubekiwe, ngokwayo, kuyinxalenye ngokupheleleyo yenkqubo yonqulo.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.21: Ukungathandazi ngexesha lokuya exesheni akuthethi ukuba umntu uhlukanisiwe nobudlelwane bakhe noThixo.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.31: Ezinye izinto, njengokufunda iKoran okanye ukuyisebenzisa ngokuthe ngqo, zinokuxhomekeka kwiimbono ezahlukahlukeneyo kuxhomekeka kwisikolo sezomthetho.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.33: Umthandazo osuswe ngexesha lokuya exesheni uyamkhulula, yaye ufanele uyenze ngaphandle kwesono.

PregnancyExercise.6: Ukuhlala usebenza kakuhle, ukhuselekile, kwisithuba ngasinye seminyaka emithathu.
PregnancyExercise.13: Ngokuqhelekileyo, ukuhambahamba, ukuqubha, neyoga ngaphambi kokubeleka kuyacetyiswa ebudeni bokukhulelwa, ngesantya esihambelana nendlela ovakalelwa ngayo.

PregnancyExercise.19: Imisebenzi enobungozi bokuwa (ukukhenketha, ukukhwela ihashe, ukukhwela ibhayisekile kwindawo enenkani)
PregnancyExercise.21: Ukuzama ngamandla ukuphakama okanye ubushushu obugqithiseleyo
PregnancyExercise.23: Intlungu, ukopha okanye ukuxinana ngexesha lomsebenzi
PregnancyExercise.25: Soloko uphulaphule imiqondiso yomzimba wakho uze uthethe nomzalamane wakho okanye ugqirha wakho ngaphambi kokuba uqale okanye utshintshe umsebenzi.
PregnancyExercise.27: Ukuziqeqesha ngokuthe rhoqo kunceda kakhulu xa ukhulelwe: eyona nto ibalulekileyo kukuhlengahlengisa indlela oziva ngayo xa ukhulelwe.

PregnancyWeekly.18: Nangona ezi mpawu zisenokungahambi kakuhle ngamanye amaxesha, zibonisa ukuba umzimba uyazivumelanisa nokukhulelwa.
PregnancyWeekly.19: Ngokufuthi ixesha lesibini leenyanga lihlala likhululekile, yaye iintshukumo zokuqala zentsana zivela.
PregnancyWeekly.21: Ezi zivalelwa phakathi kweeveki ezili-18 nelama-22, kancinane ngaphambili ukuba oku akusiyo ukukhulelwa kwakho kokuqala.
PregnancyWeekly.22: Kwisiqingatha sesithathu somntwana, umzimba ulungiselela ukubeleka, ukwanda kwesisindo nokudinwa kuyabonakala.
PregnancyWeekly.23: Ngokuqhelekileyo ezi ziqhumiso azikho rhoqo yaye azibuhlungu kakhulu; zahlukile kwiqhumiso lokubeleka.

RamadanFasting.36: I-AWA ingakunceda ukuba ulandele umjikelo wakho ngexesha leRamadan, ukuze ukwazi ukufumana le nkcazelo ngokulula kamva.
RamadanFasting.38: Iinkcukacha ezichanekileyo zokufumana iintsuku ezingaphuthwanga (ixesha, iimeko ezikhethekileyo ezinjengokukhulelwa okanye ukuncelisa) zinokwahluka ngokwemfundo yezomthetho.
RamadanFasting.40: Ukuzila ukutya ngexesha lokuya esikhathini kwakho kukuzibonela isiqabu, kungekhona ukuyeka ukwenza izinto zonqulo, kodwa kukuqinisekisa ukuba uyaphila ngexesha elifanelekileyo, uzibambe kakuhle iintsuku zakho, uze ucele ulwalathiso xa ukuthandabuza, konke oku kuya kukunceda ukuba uphile kakuhle eRamadan.

RegularIrregularCycle.1: Umjikelo oqhelekileyo okanye ongekho rhoqo: yintoni umahluko?
RegularIrregularCycle.4: Umjikelo ngamnye wokuya esikhathini uhlukile. Ukuqonda oko kuthathwa njenge "kuqhelekileyo" kunokukunceda ukuba uqonde impilo yakho ngokusondeleyo uze ubone ukungazinzi okunokwenzeka.
RegularIrregularCycle.11: Umjikelo uthathwa njengohlala njalo xa ubude bawo buhluka phakathi kweentsuku ezingama-21 nezingama-35, kungekho mahluko weentsuku ezisi-7 ukusuka kumjikelo omnye ukuya komnye.
RegularIrregularCycle.13: Eyona nto ibalulekileyo kukujonga indlela ozibetha ngayo iinyanga.
RegularIrregularCycle.15: Ibhinqa ngalinye lahlukile, into ebalulekileyo kukwazi indlela elihamba ngayo nendlela elihamba ngayo.
RegularIrregularCycle.16: Umjikelo uthathwa njengongalunganga xa ubude bawo buhluka rhoqo okanye ngokungaqondakaliyo (umehluko ungaphezu kweentsuku ezisi-7). Oku kunokubonakala njengemijikelo emifutshane kakhulu, imijikelezo emide kakhulu, okanye ukungabikho kwe-ovulation.
RegularIrregularCycle.18: Ezi mpawu zinokuba zezokwexeshana okanye zihlale zikhona kangangezihlandlo eziliqela.

RegularIrregularCycle.24: Ubunzima obungaphantsi kakhulu okanye obuphezulu kakhulu

RegularIrregularCycle.27: Iintsuku ezide kakhulu (ngaphezulu kweentsuku ezingama-90) okanye iintsuku ezimfutshane kakhulu (ngaphantsi kweentsuku ezingama-21)

ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.6: Kukho iingongoma ezimbalwa zokomoya ezinokukunceda ukuba unyamezele ukufelwa ngobulali, umonde, nemfesane.

ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.16: Ukuziva ngolo hlobo akuthethi kuthi akanalukholo, kuba umfazi ngamnye unokujamelana nentlungu yakhe ngendlela yakhe.
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.20: Emva kokuphulukana, imithetho yonqulo inokuxhomekeka kwimeko nemvelo yokopha.
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.21: Ngokukodwa, kusenokuba yimfuneko ukuhlengahlengisa phakathi kweentlobo ezahlukahlukeneyo zokopha ngaphambi kokuba kugqitywe ukuba zeziphi izenzo zonqulo ekufuneka zilandelwe.
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.27: Ukuba imeko yakho inokufuna impendulo eyahlukileyo, kungcono ukucela icebiso kumntu ofanelekayo.
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.29: Umonde (sabr) awuthethi kuthi akakho umntu olilayo okanye oziva enentlungu, kunoko, unokumkhokelela ekunyamekeleni ukholo nethemba.
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.30: Iimbonakaliso ezincinane zinokunceda ukubuyisela ngokuthe ngcembe uxolo: umthandazo, umzuzu wokukhumbula, ukuphulaphula ngokomoya, okanye ukuba khona komntu omthandayo.
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.35: Ukuphilisa kuthatha ixesha, akukho ndlela yokuhamba xa ulahlekelwe.
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.37: Akunyanzelekanga ukuba wenze yonke into ngexesha elinye, khetha oko kuvisisana nendlela ovakalelwa ngayo noko ukudingayo ngoku.
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.40: Qhubeka usenza izinto ezincinane zokomoya ukuba ziyakuthuthuzela
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.41: Funa icebiso kulo naluphi na umbuzo ongokwenkolo
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.42: Funa inkxaso xa usentlungwini kuba nzima ukuyithwala
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.44: Ukuzinyamekela, ukufuna inkxaso nokulondoloza ithemba kunokukunceda ngokuthe ngcembe ukhokele kwindlela eya eluxolweni.

ReligiousFaq.6: Imibuzo eqhelekileyo malunga namafiqh amabhinqa, ehlanganiswe kwindawo enye eneempendulo ezicacileyo.
ReligiousFaq.8: Le nkcazelo imane ifundisa. Imibuzo yonqulo kufuneka iqinisekiswe ziingcali ezifanelekileyo. I-AWA ayikhutshwa ziifatwa okanye izigqibo zonqulo ezenziwe ngomntu.
ReligiousFaq.14: Imibuzo emininzi ngokuphathelele umjikelo, umthandazo nokuzila ukutya ivela rhoqo kumfazi omnye ukuya komnye. Nazi iimpendulo eziqhelekileyo kwezo zidla ngokuvela; ukuze siqhubeke, inqaku ngalinye lixoxwa nzulu ngalo.
ReligiousFaq.16: I-Fikha yabasetyhini idibanisa imigaqo esebenzayo echaphazela ngokukodwa imizimba yabasetyhini kunye nonqulo: umjikelo, ukucoceka, umthandazo, ukuzila ukutya, i-nifas, kunye ne-istihâda.
ReligiousFaq.17: Ziziphi izihloko eziphambili ezifunyenwe yifiqh yamabhinqa?
ReligiousFaq.18: Iquka ngokukodwa ixesha lokuya esikhathini kunye nomjikelo, ukucoceka ngokwesiko, i-ghusl, umthandazo nokuzila ukutya ngexesha nasemva kokuya esikhathini, i-nifas, kunye ne-istihâda.
ReligiousFaq.19: Nguwuphi umahluko okhoyo phakathi kokuya exesheni, ukugalela igazi emva kokubeleka nokugalela igazi ngokungekho mthethweni?
ReligiousFaq.20: Ixesha lokuya esikhathini (hayd) lilandela umjikelo oqhelekileyo, i-nifas ivela emva kokubeleka, kwaye i-istihâda ibhekisela ekopha okungaqhelekanga, ngaphandle komjikelo.
ReligiousFaq.21: Kwenzeka ntoni kumthandazo ngexesha lokuya exesheni?
ReligiousFaq.22: Umthandazo uyasuswa ngeli xesha: uyamkhulula, ukuba uyenze ngaphandle kwesono.
ReligiousFaq.23: Kwenzeka ntoni ngokuzila ukutya ngexesha lokuya exesheni?
ReligiousFaq.24: Ukuzila ukutya nako kuyasuswa; iintsuku ezingazilwanga ziqhutywa kamva (qadaa), ngaphandle kweRamadan.
ReligiousFaq.25: Kutheni imithandazo ephoswayo ingaqhelaniswa nokuzila ukutya?
ReligiousFaq.26: Lo mahluko ungowesimo sezenzo ezimbini: umthandazo usenziwa imihla ngemihla kwaye uphindaphindwa, ngoxa ukuzila ukutya kunyaka ngamnye kwaye kugxininiswa kwinyanga enye.
ReligiousFaq.27: Umthandazo uqala nini emva kokuya exesheni?
ReligiousFaq.28: Nje ukuba iinyanga ziphelile yaye kwenziwa i-ghusl, umthandazo uqala kwakhona njengesiqhelo, ngaphandle kokulibazisa.
ReligiousFaq.30: I-Ghusl yindawo enkulu yokuhlambuluka evumela umntu ukuba abuyele kwimeko yokucoceka ngokwesiko efunekayo ukuze aphinde athandaze nezinye izenzo zonqulo.
ReligiousFaq.31: Yintoni omele uyenze ukuba awuyazi ukuba ixesha lokuya esikhathini liphelile?
ReligiousFaq.32: Ukuqaphela ukungabikho kokopha ngokupheleleyo ixesha elaneleyo, kunokuba kuxhomekeke kwimbonakalo nje enye, kunceda ukucacisa imeko.
ReligiousFaq.33: Ngaba ezinye iindlela zonqulo zinokuqhutywa ngexesha lokuya exesheni?
ReligiousFaq.34: Ewe: I-dhikr, izibongozo, umnikelo wokunceda, ukufunda ngonqulo, nezinye izenzo zobubele zisafumaneka.
ReligiousFaq.35: Kutheni iimpendulo ezithile zingahluka kuxhomekeke kwimeko?
ReligiousFaq.36: I-Fiqh yindawo yokutolika: izimvo zingahluka kuxhomekeke kwisikolo sezomthetho kunye neemeko zobuqu, ngaphandle kokuba nayiphi na imbono iyodwa ibe yinto epheleleyo ngokwayo.
ReligiousFaq.37: I-fiqh yamaSilamsi ibandakanya ukungafani okuziwayo kokutolikwa kwamanqaku athile.
ReligiousFaq.38: Ngokuxhomekeke kumthombo oxoxwa ngawo, umbuzo omnye unokufumana iimpendulo ezahlukileyo kancinane.
ReligiousFaq.40: Ukulandela umthombo ofanelekileyo rhoqo, kunokuba utshintshe uluvo lwakho rhoqo ngokusekelwe kwempendulo oyifumanayo, kunokukunceda ugcine umkhwa wakho ucacile yaye uzolile.
ReligiousFaq.41: Ezinye iimeko zisaqhubeka zinzima ukuzisombulula ngokusekelwe kwingcaciso enye eqhelekileyo.
ReligiousFaq.42: Akukho nto icacileyo ngokuphathelele ixesha lokugqiba kwexesha lokuya exesheni
ReligiousFaq.43: Uhlobo lokopha luhlala lungaqinisekanga (ukuya esikhathini, ukuyeka ukuya exesheni, ezinye)
ReligiousFaq.44: Iimbambano zisaqhubeka malunga nesidingo sokwenza i-ghusl
ReligiousFaq.48: Xa imeko ingeyomntu, inzima, okanye ihlala ihleli, ayikwazi ukusonjululwa ngolwazi oluthe kratya. Ukuya kwiingcali eziqeqeshiweyo, ezinokukuqonda imeko yakho, kuyinto efanelekileyo. I-AWA ayikhutshwa ziifatwa okanye izigqibo zonqulo ezenziwe ngomntu.
ReligiousFaq.49: I-fiqh yabasetyhini igubungela iinkalo ezininzi zenkolo yabasetyhini
ReligiousFaq.50: Ezinye iinkcukacha zinokwahluka ngokusemthethweni kuxhomekeke kwisikolo sezomthetho
ReligiousFaq.51: Ulwazi ngokubanzi aluthathi indawo yokhokelo lonqulo
ReligiousFaq.52: Ukungaqiniseki okuqhubekayo kufanele kuphakamiswe nomphengululi ofanelekileyo
ReligiousFaq.53: I-AWA ⁇  indima yayo kukufundisa, hayi ukukhupha iifata
ReligiousFaq.54: Imibuzo edla ngokubuzwa ngefiqh yowesifazane  ⁇  AWA
